## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contract-level change.

## Safety and data

- [ ] No credentials, addresses, cookies, voucher identifiers or personal order history are committed.
- [ ] Prices and scores include a source and freshness policy.
- [ ] The change does not perform checkout or payment.
- [ ] New or changed external code retains its required attribution and license notices.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run optimize`
- [ ] `npm run store:demo`
- [ ] `npm audit`
